page.overview:
Who is Amy?

Amy is a girl in Bart's gym class. She is a girl with blond hair, who bares a striking resemblance to Alex Whitney. Like many of the other students, she is a background character.

In "My Fair Laddy", Coach Krupt mentioned her name when he bombarded her with a dodgeball. She squealed and was instantly knocked to the ground.
